newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE ends weaker as Wall Street tumbles.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE ends weaker as Wall Street tumbles.

text.p: UK's FTSE 100 share index finished moderately lower on Thursday in jittery trade as investors awaited key U.S. economic data for an indication on the future of U.S. interest rate policy.
The Wall Street stumbled, with the Dow down 49 points to a three-month low when London markets closed.
Under the weight of Wall Street, the leading blue chip index finished points 22.0 points lower at 4,214.6 as decliners beat advancers 56 to 41.
